_comment: Machine-readable 'graduatable watch-list': foundation resources (skill OR command OR agent) still maintained full-impl in-house because NO vendor has cleared the curation bar yet. DOCTRINE (specs/dev-command-vendor-graduation): classify by KIND, not popularity. A resource that wraps an EXTERNAL TOOL is graduatable and belongs here — popularity only changes the probability/timeline a vendor emerges, never the category (a niche tool like Proxmox is low-probability, NOT permanent). Only resources that encode the foundation's OWN workflow/discipline (TDD, audit loop, Explore->Specify->Plan, verification/security) are permanent — and a vendor encroaching there is the curation-discover.sh moat-WARNING signal, not a graduation. scripts/curation-discover.sh tags any cleared proposal whose repo path matches an entry's matchKeywords as graduationFor that foundationSkill; LLM-free, deterministic, never lowers a gate. Fragmentation is NOT a blocker: a split-tooling domain (e.g. k8s = helm+kubectl+kustomize) graduates to a '+'-joined multi-skill vendor bundle, which the registry already supports. matchKeywords are deliberately specific product/library names (precision over recall). Concept-level wrappers without a stable product name in repo paths (dev-mcp, dev-rag, dev-ai-integration) are watchable in doctrine but omitted here: repo-path keyword match has too-low recall for them (e.g. 'rag' matches 'storage') — revisit with a content-based matcher.

entries.graduationTrigger: a Flutter-team or >=bar community agent-skill appears -> registry candidate -> REDUCE command, POINT agent
a neutral auth meta-skill of comparable breadth across better-auth/Lucia/NextAuth/Clerk/Supabase appears (else permanent)
a broad i18n vendor skill appears, or the pack narrows to Lingui-only -> POINT

a single k8s agent-skill OR a '+'-joined bundle (helm+kubectl+kustomize) clears the bar; fragmentation is not a blocker (registry supports multi-skill vendorId). Deep-dive flagged: define the target bundle composition.
a Neovim agent-skill clears the bar -> graduate dev-neovim AND qa-neovim together (same tech)
low-probability (niche homelab audience), NOT permanent — a Proxmox skill clearing the bar graduates it
